data.body:
[P1] Preserve the external callback failure classification

After a successful submitter, an external failure with `ErrorType: "PaymentError"` now checkpoints only that type. Reconstruction produces `StepError`, which the `waitForCallback` mapper converts to `CallbackSubmitterError`. Consequently, existing `CallbackExternalError` handlers miss the failure, and submission-recovery logic can run even though submission succeeded. This affects both live execution and replay. Preserve callback provenance alongside the underlying error type, or retain this wrapper, and update the typed-external tests to require `CallbackExternalError`.
